expected_learning: First Hamming-2 double-mutant data (IKGV, IVGV, IYGV, INLV, FNGV, WNGV): closes the zero-double blind spot and calibrates epistasis for the surrogate.
Complete aromatic/tolerant scan at pos54 (Y/W/F/I/M) on the 2.8315 backbone — highest-prior shot at a new best.
pos39 W/F/Y and pos40 W/Y/L/G density refines the INGA neighborhood (21/76 singles measured -> ~30/76 after round).
INKV resolves whether pos41 tolerates anything beyond G (K41 unmeasured, V54 good).
Noise-aware final verdict: replicate-verified best with gap > 0.7 vs 2.8315, or INGA retained.
policy_change_reason: E-R3-NO-GAIN: Round 3 exploitation at model-mean ranks produced no gain; shift weight from model-ranked EXPLOIT to parent-fitness-prioritized LOCAL Hamming-1 around INGA (2.8315) and INGV (2.2863).
E-CV-NOISE: with +-0.55 noise floor, model ranks below the top few are uninformative; spend slots on high-prior beat candidates (pos54 aromatics, pos39 W/F, Hamming-2 doubles).
E-DBL-BLINDSPOT: zero measured double mutants; reserve slots for IKGV/IVGV (components measured >=1.9) to test additivity and potentially clear 2.8315.
E-P54-AROMATIC: WT Y54 and W54/F54 unmeasured on the 2.8315 backbone; INGY first (top prior), then INGW/INGF plus tolerated INGI/INGM.

E-UNCERTAIN-DEAD: uncertainty arm cut 4->1 because round-3 uncertainty slots yielded nothing and its top items carry measured-dead residues; retain exactly 1 near-plateau extreme (INKV: K41 unmeasured, V54 good).
E-DIVERSE-LOW-YIELD: diverse arm cut 2->1 in final round; keep exactly 1 clean distant guard (PYFV r2; rejected HRVH r1 due to measured-dead V41).
primary_observations: Round 3 (24 assays) produced no improvement: round best INGV 2.2863, IKGA 2.0137, IVGA 1.9130; all < best 2.8315.
Surrogate CV RMSE 0.551, Spearman 0.573 -> noise floor ~+-0.55; the 2.8315 vs 2.2863 gap is NOT statistically resolvable; neighbor confirmation required.
Pools exclude all 72 measured sequences (incl. INGA, INGV, IKGA, IVGA) -> direct replication impossible; use neighbor-confirmation and Hamming-2 plateau doubles.
Zero measured double mutants (largest blind spot); Hamming-2 doubles IKGV/IVGV/IYGV/INLV are the only available epistasis probes.
pos54 pocket tolerant: V/S/T measured >=1.7; aromatic ring (Y=WT, W, F) on ING* backbone unmeasured — strongest remaining shot at beating 2.8315.
Measured-dead at pos41 E/R/Q/V/T and pos54 K/R/P/D; uncertainty DEAD combos and HRVH (V41) excluded.
risks: Single unreplicated 2.8315: if it is a noisy high outlier (+-0.55 floor), all 24 near-neighbor attempts may fail to clear it.
Epistasis may depress Hamming-2 doubles below additive expectation (components ~1.9-2.3); G41 near-essential may cap pos41 probes (INIA/INMA/INLV/INKV).
23/24 slots are near INGA/INGV neighborhood: minimal new global coverage; surrogate generalization gains limited in final round.
If the true peak is narrow (only INGA), most R4 returns land 0.6-2.3 and best stays 2.8315.
Guard reduced to 1 sequence (PYFV): diversity-derived model robustness no longer testable this round.

selection_parameters.dead_residue_exclusion: Never combine measured-dead residues: pos41 E/R/Q/V/T, pos54 K/R/P/D; skip pool items INKA/INGE/INPA; reject HRVH r1 (V41) -> diversity guard = PYFV r2.
selection_parameters.naming_note: Pool convention letter1=pos39, letter2=pos40, letter3=pos41, letter4=pos54 (INGW=W54, INKV=K41, IKGV=K40+V54); INMA/INIA are M/I at pos41.
selection_parameters.precommitted_final_selection_rule: Declare a new best only if replicate-verified and gap > 0.7 vs 2.8315 (> noise floor 0.55); gaps < ~0.7 treated as unresolved ties -> INGA retained as best.
selection_parameters.priority_order: 1) pos54 aromatics/tolerant on ING* (Y>W>F>I>M), 2) Hamming-2 doubles IKGV/IVGV, 3) pos39 W/F(+Y), 4) pos41 I/M/K/L (+V54), 5) pos40 W/Y/L/G pocket probes, 6) exactly 1 distant guard.
selection_parameters.replicate_logic: Direct replication impossible (anchors excluded from pools); use Hamming-1 neighbor confirmation around INGA/INGV and Hamming-2 plateau doubles instead.
selection_parameters.source_ranks: source_action + source_rank cited exactly as in runs/adaptive/omnigent_seed_000/round_03/candidate_pools.json.

stop_conditions: Final round: all 24 slots spent; no early stop; run halts at end of round 4.
Pre-committed accept rule: designate new best only if replicate-confirmed measurement exceeds 2.8315 by > 0.7; otherwise report INGA 2.8315 as best.
Terminate adaptive loop after round 4 regardless of outcomes (budget exhausted; preregistration fixed).
